changeSet.author: hirevo
changeSet.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS workflow;

changeSet.author: hirevo
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE workflow.approval_workflows ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, module VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, trigger_rules JSONB, is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, priority INT DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() ); CREATE INDEX idx_wf_module_priority ON workflow.approval_workflows(tenant_id, module, priority DESC) WHERE is_active;
CREATE TABLE workflow.workflow_steps ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, approval_workflow_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow.approval_workflows(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, step_order INT NOT NULL, approver_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (approver_type IN ('direct_manager','department_head','specific_user','specific_role','position_level')), approver_user_id UUID, approver_role_id UUID, approver_job_level_id UUID, is_mandatory BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, auto_approve_after_hours INT, UNIQUE (approval_workflow_id, step_order) );

changeSet.author: hirevo
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE workflow.approval_instances ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, approval_workflow_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow.approval_workflows(id), module VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, reference_id UUID NOT NULL, current_step INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','approved','rejected','cancelled','expired')), initiated_by UUID, initiated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), finalized_at TIMESTAMPTZ ); CREATE INDEX idx_wi_ref ON workflow.approval_instances(module, reference_id); CREATE INDEX idx_wi_pending ON workflow.approval_instances(tenant_id, status) WHERE status='pending';
CREATE TABLE workflow.approval_actions ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, approval_instance_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow.approval_instances(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, step_order INT NOT NULL, actor_user_id UUID NOT NULL, action VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('approved','rejected','delegated','commented','recalled')), comment TEXT, acted_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() );

changeSet.author: hirevo
